opis: Early MORNING on the meadow from the reference picture, at SUNRISE: the big round orange SUN is just coming up over the far hills, the sky pink, gold and pale blue, long soft morning light over the dewy grass, a little mist in the hollows. In the front a small round MOLEHILL of brown earth with a hole in the top; the MOLE has just climbed half out of it, his front paws on the grass, blinking at the light with one paw shading his eyes, amazed. The SQUIRREL stands beside the molehill pointing happily at the rising sun; the ROE DEER stands a little behind, smiling at the mole. A few birds fly over the sun. Fresh, bright and hopeful - the first morning the mole has ever seen.
